gpt.text:
Run those three commands in order; they’re a standard “pick best module → try system candidates → propose next fix” loop.

## 1) Select best module candidate and update champion
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```
What it does:
- Executes the module-level experiment sweep defined in `module_registry.yaml`.
- Compares results to the current champion (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`).
- If something beats the champion by your selection rule, it should promote/update the champion (exact behavior depends on your tool, but `--select-best` implies promotion).

What to look for in stdout/logs:
- Which candidate (module/config) was selected.
- The metric deltas vs current champion (your handoff shows tuning_mean/min and lockbox_mean/min).

## 2) Run system-level candidate experiments
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```
What it does:
- Tries end-to-end “system” configurations defined in `system_candidates.yaml`.
- Typically validates that a promising module-level improvement holds up in integrated runs (often closer to lockbox behavior).

What to check:
- Whether any candidate becomes a new PASS candidate.
- Whether anything is INCONCLUSIVE (often means not enough runs, high variance, or partial failures).

## 3) Generate a “next fix” plan/report
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```
What it does:
- Emits a Markdown report suggesting the most promising next tweak(s), based on recent results and gaps (e.g., “tuning improved but lockbox regressed”).

Output:
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`

## Practical notes
- If you want a clean run, ensure any prior run state/artifacts won’t confuse selection (some systems cache results); if your tooling supports it, consider a `--clean`/`--reset` option.
- If step (1) doesn’t produce a new champion, step (3) is usually the most useful for direction.

If you paste the stdout from step (1) (or the generated `next_fix.md`), I can help interpret whether the new results are actually better (especially given your tuning vs lockbox means/mins).
